title: Obubaka bwa SMS
adminsOnly: Kino kkitundu kkiri ba NetGecko Admin bokka.
settingsDescription: Biterekeddwa mu Airtable — bikola ku mirimu egya buli lunaku n'okutuma okw'omukono.
disabledInfo: Okutuma kugaanyiziddwa — omulimu gwa buli lunaku n'okutuma okw'omukono tekukola kintu. Osobola okwekuba ebisuliddwa wansi.
liveWarning: Enkola OKUTUUSE — obubaka bugenda ku nnamba z'essimu za balimi ze ddala ng'okuyita mu Africa's Talking.
testInfoPhone: Enkola EKIGEZZA — obubaka bwona butumibwa ku {{phone}} n'ogatandikibwa [TEST]; balimi tebafuna kintu era loans teziwandiikibwa.
testInfoNoPhone: Enkola EKIGEZZA nga tewali nnamba y'okugezesako — obubaka businizibwa butereevu, tewali kitutumibwa.
jobDescription: Efuga buli lunaku ku ssaawa emu ez'okumakya (EAT) bw'ekoleddwa. Ennonkola ezaawezebwa ku loan teziddamu.
disabledRun: Tewali kisimbuse — ekikola kigaanyiziddwa. Kikole mu Enteekateeka engulu okusooka.
sentTestSummary: SMS {{sent}} ez'okugeza zitumiddwa ku nnamba y'okugezesako, {{errors}} zannyanirwa.
scheduleDescription: Eky'ennonkola zanditumidde leero n'ennaku eziddako, nga bikebbeddwa ku loans ze ddala. Tewali kintu kino kikutumibwa.
rulesDescription: Ziggyibwa butereevu ku ttendekero lya Airtable erya “SMS”. Kyusa ennonkola eyo — olukalala luno luzza obuggya buli lw'ojja.
logDescription: Obubaka obuwandiikiddwa ku loans (fields za SMS date). Obupya butanika.
confirmContent: Kino kiyituma obubaka obulinobwa leero ku ssimu za balimi ng'okuyita mu Africa's Talking era buwandiikibwa ku loans. Tekisoboka kukyusa.
confirmTest: Enkola EKIGEZZA: obubaka obulinobwa leero butumibwa ku {{phone}} yokka, nga butandikibwa [TEST]. Balimi tebafuna kintu era loans teziwandiikibwa.
confirmDisabled: Ekikola kigaanyiziddwa — tewali kisimbuka. Kikole mu Enteekateeka okusooka olw'okutuma ddala.
runError: Omulimu gwa SMS gwannyanirwa. Gezaako nate oba kebba logs za server.
